(Dhātup. xxii, 68; xiv, 17) प्यायते (pf. पप्ये Gr.; aor. अप्यायि, ib.; अप्यासम्, AitĀr.; Prec. प्यायिषीमहि or प्यासिषीमहि, AV.; VS.; Br.; fut. प्यास्यते or प्यायिष्यते Gr.; प्याता, प्यायिता, ib.), to swell, be exuberant, overflow: Caus. प्याययति, ˚ते, AV. &c.; (Pass. प्याय्यते, Br.) to make overflow, fill up (mostly in comp. with आ- See आ-प्यै; cf. √ पि, पी).
a: प्यै — {c1c} A. (प्यायते, पीन) 1 To grow, increase, swell; Bk. 6. 33 --2 To become full or exuberant. --3 To overfill, surcharge. --Caus. (प्या ययति ते) 1 To increase, enlarge, make fat or comfortable; Ms. 9. 314. --2 To gratify, regale.
